lq.q: Find the Fourier series for \(f(x)=x(2l-x)\) in \((0,2l)\) of period \(2l\).
answer: Step Marks Fourier series form with period \(2l\) (1) \(a_0=\frac{1}{l}\int_0^{2l}x(2l-x)dx=\frac{4l^2}{3}\) (2) \(a_n=\frac{1}{l}\int_0^{2l}x(2l-x)\cos\frac{n\pi x}{l}dx=-\frac{4l^2}{n^2\pi^2}\) (4) \(b_n=\frac{1}{l}\int_0^{2l}x(2l-x)\sin\frac{n\pi x}{l}dx=\frac{4l^2}{n\pi}(-1)^{n+1}\) (4) Thus, \(x(2l-x)=\frac{2l^2}{3}-\frac{4l^2}{\pi^2}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n^2}\cos\frac{n\pi x}{l}+\frac{4l^2}{\pi}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n}\sin\frac{n\pi x}{l}\) (4)
